text:
Grace: Heads-up: NeonCo asked for a formal 'catalog runway' so they can finish model changes without emergency pins. They want up to 12 weeks and a credit scheme tied to improvement metrics. cc @Omar @Ivy
Omar: What's the pinned model + observed delta? we need the numbers before committing to credits.
Grace: They're currently pinned to rwd-13b-std, traffic ~70QPS, eu-heavy. Canary snapshot shows semantic delta ~3.7% and p95 +10ms. Embedding recall@10 down ~2.3pp.
Ivy: 3.7% is above our 3% guardrail for tier-1. Curious how much is long-tail vs top-100 queries. Can we get per-segment diffs?
Cal: Proposal: create a reusable "catalog-runway" lane with these elements: TTLs (14/30/84d), a staged-credit escrow (frontloaded, releasable weekly based on improvement score), mandatory weekly eval snapshots, shadow-serve 48h before any bump, and automated rollback webhooks.
Ivy: The escrow idea is interesting: hold credits in a customer ledger and only apply them if weekly improvement >= threshold. That reduces revenue risk.
Omar: Ops needs a precise preflight checklist that gates each bump. Draft checklist below:
```text
- customer-seed eval: semantic delta + per-segment breakdown
- embedding similarity: median cosine delta + recall@k
- perf smoke: p50/p95 vs baseline (regional)
- shadow-serve telemetry 48h OK
- KV-cache warm/cold simulation
- structured-output invariants (field presence/order)
- fallback variant exercised
```
Cal: Bench exit rules suggestion: 14d bridge (requires delta <=2.5% or targeted mitigation), 30d runway (delta <=2% and p95 within +6ms), 84d runway (delta <=3% but requires weekly improvement trend and a mitigation plan).
Grace: For credits: suggest staged escrow bands: 10% for 14d, 15% for 30d, 22% for 84d, with weekly releases only if the weekly improvement score (weighted semantic + embedding + perf) is non-negative. Legal/Finance sign-off for >15%.
Ivy: Add structured-output field-level regression tests. Last quarter we saw JSON key reorder cause user-facing bugs. Also require embedding schema verification so vector dims/order unchanged.
Omar: Implementation notes: CI job runs weekly evals, computes improvement score, posts status to the customer channel, and only triggers canary bump when green. Webhook triggers rollback and notifies on-call. I'll own the webhook and gating job.
Cal: I'll draft the lane spec, escrow flow, sample SLOs, and a customer comms template (clear rollback + credits mechanics). Assign to me.
Grace: Action items: (1) Cal draft spec and comms by Tue EOD, (2) Omar build gating webhook + shadow-serve infra prototype, (3) Ivy pull per-segment diffs and construct customer seed set, (4) Legal-bot please attach contract snippet for escrow & rollback.
legal-bot: FYI 1 - any credit >15% requires legal review; include explicit rollback SLA and ledger accounting.
billing-bot: Reminder: discounts over 15% need finance approval and a billing PR. Use /approve-discount.
Grace: NeonCo needs a firm yes/no in 6 business days. Let's keep updates short. We'll go over the draft in product sync. :hourglass:
